newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: FENCING-POZDNIAKOV ADDS WORLD CROWN TO OLYMPIC TITLE.
newsitem.headline: FENCING-POZDNIAKOV ADDS WORLD CROWN TO OLYMPIC TITLE.

text.p: Russia's Stanislaw Pozdniakov added fencing's world sabre title to his 1996 Olympic gold on Wednesday with a 15-12 victory over Italy's Luigi Tarantino.
Tarantino, ranked 15th in the world, had defeated Olympic bronze medallist and world number two Damien Touya of France in his semifinal but fell just short against the world's top-ranked sabre man.
In the men's foil Ukraine's Sergei Golubitsky triumphed over Kim Young-ho of South Korea in a tense final.
Golubitsky surged into an 11-3 lead and Kim levelled at 11-11 before the Ukrainian triumphed 15-14.
The victory followed the world number seven's impressive 15-7 victory over Atlanta silver medallist and current world number one Lionel Plumenail of France in the semifinals.
